kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أشرئب (form IVq)
# أَشْرَئِبُّ (ʔašraʔibbu) /ʔaʃ.ra.ʔib.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# أَشْرَئِبَّ (ʔašraʔibba) /ʔaʃ.ra.ʔib.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# أَشْرَئِبِّ (ʔašraʔibbi) /ʔaʃ.ra.ʔib.bi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
